reason: Dev-only ESLint plugin dependency. eslint-plugin-import-x 4.17.1, the latest release, accepts only minimatch 9 or 10, and no patched 9 or 10 release exists. Its no-internal-modules rule imports makeRe, which minimatch 11 removed, so an override stops ESLint from loading the plugin. The plugin matches only the repository's own lint configuration patterns, never untrusted patterns.
